description: EAGER: SSDIM: Generating Synthetic Data on Interdependent Food, Energy, and Transportation Networks via Stochastic, Bi-level Optimization is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Sauleh Siddiqui, Johns Hopkins University (jhu.edu). Unanticipated challenges, such as natural disasters, oil spils, blackouts, result in disruptions to the respective engineering systems and lead to a range of complex social effects. Therefore, the study of such events requires a framework that integrates engineering with the social, behavioral, and economic sciences. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-y5k1-yx25. Keywords: data generation, bi-level optimization, food, energy, interdependencies, critical infrastructures. Published 2019-09-16. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
